svg.text: Best discriminator level against signal rate N, with the 5 % tolerance band
B. Background known precisely (from a separate long dark run)
N: signal rate in counts/s at the valley level (log scale)
best level |v| (mV)
valleys 4.0 mV (light 13:59), 3.8 mV (light 17:24): the lowest level allowed
GUI value (V)
within 5 % in all four pairings
one level for all four (least worst-case time)
best level, dark 13:20 + light 13:59
best level, dark 13:20 + light 17:24
best level, dark 16:36 + light 13:59
best level, dark 16:36 + light 17:24
Dots: the requested N (offset sideways per pairing); bars: 16-84 % range of the best level over 400 Poisson resamples of every raw count.
No level is within 5 % in all four pairings for N <= 0.1 counts/s (unshaded): there the two dark scans disagree more than the band is wide.
In at least one pairing the 5 % band reaches the valley from N ~ 282, and the best level from N ~ 1995 counts/s (grid of 20 N values per decade): beyond that
the true lower edge or optimum may lie below the valley, which this analysis does not trust (see fig_inputs).

No level is within 5 % in all four pairings for N <= 0.2 counts/s (unshaded): there the two dark scans disagree more than the band is wide.
In at least one pairing the 5 % band reaches the valley from N ~ 562, and the best level from N ~ 3981 counts/s (grid of 20 N values per decade): beyond that
the true lower edge or optimum may lie below the valley, which this analysis does not trust (see fig_inputs).
eps(v) from room-light scans (light 13:59, light 17:24); b(v) from the 2026-11-10 dark scans (dark 13:20, dark 16:36). R8486 at ~1000 V (operator; HV not in the files).
N is the signal rate that would be counted at the valley level; quantum efficiency and pulses below the valley are not included. Every level shown is below 10 mV: valid only
with the cables routed as during these scans (manual p. 22, DISC-output pickup).
Levels resolved to the scanned grid: 0.2 mV steps below 6 mV, 0.4 mV above. Within 5 % of the best figure of merit = within 10.8 % of the shortest counting time.
